Hi team,

We just completed the self-serve signup and poked around the Redwood GitHub app demo. A few quick questions before we book a live demo:

- Does the app require write permissions on issues/repos to manage KV/cache metadata? We're cautious about least privilege.
- Any guidance on webhook delivery guarantees and retries for high-volume repos?
- Curious about on-prem/private deployment options for code that must stay inside our VPC.

Subject: Re: [RepoGuardian] Interested in Redwood GitHub App (self-signup)

Hi Samir — thanks for signing up and for the clear list of questions. Quick answers inline, and a proposal for a short call: 

1) Permissions: the app only needs repo read + metadata write for the minimal integration. We can provide a scoped service account and a read-only option that stores metadata in your VPC for Private deployments.

2) Webhooks: our hosted app retries for up to 24 hours with exponential backoff; for high-volume repos we recommend our event-batching proxy (low-latency path) — we can run numbers on your traffic mix in the call.

3) On-prem: yes — Redwood Private supports VPC/on-prem deploys. If you need air-gapped, we have an install kit and offline keys process.

Would you be available for a 30-minute technical demo and integration Q&A tomorrow (Wed) between 10:00–13:00 PT or Thursday 14:00–16:00 PT? If those don't work, send a few slots and we’ll adapt.

I’ve copied Marissa (AE) and Jasmine (Solutions) to join the call.

Best,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0142
